text:
Which statements about an aqueous acid are correct?
1
Ammonia is formed when solid ammonium nitrate is added to an aqueous acid.
2
Effervescence is seen when sodium carbonate is added to an aqueous acid.
3
Methyl orange becomes yellow when added to an aqueous acid.
4
Red litmus remains red when added to an aqueous acid.
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
